kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ينذئف (form VII)
# يَنْذَئِفُ (yanḏaʔifu) /jan.ða.ʔi.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# يَنْذَئِفَ (yanḏaʔifa) /jan.ða.ʔi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# يَنْذَئِفْ (yanḏaʔif) /jan.ða.ʔif/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
